name: Methylphenidate ER
summary: Methylphenidate ER (Concerta) is a central nervous system (CNS) stimulant that blocks the reuptake of norepinephrine and dopamine into presynaptic neurons. It is indicated for the treatment of ADHD and functions through a controlled release mechanism providing therapeutic effects for up to 12 hours.
